lens: responsive mobile task completion, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The candidate build has zero horizontal overflow at 375, 390, 430, and 844-by-390 viewports. At 390 pixels the Person field clears the fixed dock, capture minimization and Escape work, primary controls are at least 44 pixels, focus order is inspectable, dark and reduced-motion modes respond, and 200-percent text reflows without horizontal overflow. VoiceOver, a real virtual keyboard, background and relaunch, and real-device browser behavior remain untested.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-11-system-ui-click-acceptance-001.json; output/playwright/2026-08-11-ts-99-workspace-offline-mobile-final.png; output/playwright/2026-08-11-ts-99-workspace-text-200.png; mobile dimension trace task_legibility=3, information_hierarchy=3, evidence_control=3, platform_interaction=2, accessibility=2, state_completeness=1, feedback_recovery=2, visual_craft=3, performance_feel=2.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can start and inspect the candidate-build workflow on responsive mobile Chromium without clipping, but assistive and lifecycle reliability is not yet proven and the live product still has no usable account entry.
findings.recommendation: Run the complete restored production loop on a small and large physical phone with VoiceOver, accessibility text, virtual keyboard, landscape, background, relaunch, offline transition, and retry.
findings.verification: Identity, source, ambiguity, decisions, Wiki, People, sign-out, and recovery remain named, ordered, unclipped, reachable, and duplicate-free across the real-device matrix.

strengths: The empty workspace now reveals the first Person task above the fixed dock instead of spending a viewport on idle Agent content.
Screenshot owner, crop, redaction, replace, cancel, and Escape are usable at 390 pixels.
Sign out is named, visible, 44 by 44 pixels, and does not create horizontal overflow.
missing_evidence: Virtual-keyboard, physical-device landscape, background, and relaunch evidence.
A complete mobile production state loop with a reachable backend.
open_questions: Does the fixed bottom dock remain non-obstructive when the real keyboard and accessibility text are both active?
